title: Town Hall proposal body
description: A proposal to the society's Town Hall (register row DK1720; spec-delta S1428), distinct from the Market's `proposal`. `kind` names the matter: policy, course, learning_path, institution, setting and rule_change are votable; code_article, safety_floor, money_creation and legal are reserved by default and a reserved matter is refused by the log (the list is configuration, not schema). `key` and `value` are the change an enactment would make. The vote runs from `opens_at` to `closes_at`; `thread` names the forum thread where it is discussed. Chain: none (prev is null).
